Built the sign-in screen in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`. It includes:

- Email and password fields (mock data pre-filled with a wrong password)
- Show/hide toggle on the password field (eye icon, `aria-pressed`)
- "Remember this device" checkbox
- "Forgot password?" link button
- An error banner (`role="alert"`) shown initially, reflecting the failed sign-in, wired to the password field via `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby`
- A loading state on submit — clicking "Sign in" shows a spinner + "Signing in…" and disables inputs, then returns to the error state (mocked, no backend)

Since no `node_modules`/type info for `@strata/react` was available in this folder, I built it with plain semantic HTML and CSS Modules using Strata's CSS custom properties (with sensible fallbacks) for colors, spacing, radius, and fonts, plus logical CSS properties so it adapts correctly across brands, dark mode, and the RTL locale.
